roadmap.title: From Retail Operations to Junior Data Analyst
roadmap.tagline: Translate retail spreadsheet domain knowledge into production-grade SQL, Python data wrangling, and an executive-ready business analytics portfolio.
outcomes: Write multi-table SQL queries utilizing CTEs, window functions, and aggregations to answer retail unit economics questions.
Clean, transform, and join messy multi-source business data using Python, Pandas, and NumPy without breaking execution pipelines.
Perform exploratory data analysis and create clear, publication-quality visualizations with Seaborn and Matplotlib.
Structure and document an end-to-end data analysis pipeline on GitHub including a clean README, business narrative, and executive summary slide deck.
Translate raw business requests into specific analytical queries and operational recommendations.

phases.title: Production SQL for Business Operations
phases.focus: Bypass basic SELECT syntax and leverage your spreadsheet logic (VLOOKUP, SUMIFS) into relational joins, CTEs, and window functions using PostgreSQL.
objectives: Master relational database concepts, primary/foreign keys, and data schemas.
Write advanced analytical queries using Common Table Expressions (CTEs) and window functions.
Calculate business metrics like Month-over-Month (MoM) revenue, rolling 7-day averages, and customer lifetime value (LTV) in pure SQL.

tasks.title: Set up local Postgres and load retail transaction tables
tasks.detail: Install PostgreSQL and DBeaver. Import an open retail dataset (orders, products, customers) and establish primary/foreign key integrity checks. Confirm row counts and data types.

tasks.title: Solve 30 operational query scenarios
tasks.detail: Translate common operational questions into SQL: identifying dead inventory, top return rates by store, and repeat customer cohorts using CTEs and subqueries.

tasks.title: Build a window-function metrics audit script
tasks.detail: Write SQL queries computing running sales totals, MoM sales retention percentages, and customer ranking per product category using LAG, LEAD, and OVER(PARTITION BY).

tasks.title: Package Phase 1 SQL artifact
tasks.detail: Format queries following standard SQL style guides, add inline comments justifying logic, and commit the script file to a GitHub repository.

resources.title: Mode Analytics SQL Tutorial
resources.why: Offers hands-on business-oriented SQL exercises moving fast from joins to window functions.

resources.title: PostgreSQL Official Documentation
resources.why: Authoritative reference for window function syntax, aggregate behaviors, and data types.

project.title: Retail Operations SQL Audit
project.brief: Write a single structured .sql script solving five executive operational questions on a 100k+ row multi-table retail database, computing churn, rolling order value, and category margins.
project.deliverable: A well-commented .sql file containing runnable queries alongside a brief markdown report summarizing the metrics.

phases.checkpoint: You can calculate a rolling 30-day average and customer rank per region in PostgreSQL using window functions without searching for syntax.

phases.title: Applied Python & Pandas for Data Cleaning
phases.focus: Replace Excel-based data preparation with repeatable Python and Pandas workflows, treating code as a reliable, automated data pipeline.
objectives: Read, inspect, clean, and manipulate multi-column tabular datasets using Pandas.
Handle null values, mismatched types, date parsing, and string anomalies systematically.
Perform complex group operations, pivot tables, and joins that break traditional spreadsheet software.

tasks.title: Set up a modern Python virtual environment and JupyterLab
tasks.detail: Configure a local virtual environment with Python 3, Pandas, and JupyterLab. Run smoke tests verifying environment stability.

tasks.title: Build dirty data transformation recipes
tasks.detail: Ingest 3 raw retail datasets containing unparsed dates, invalid currency strings, and mixed nulls. Standardize columns using .apply(), regex string operations, and .astype().

tasks.title: Construct automated reconciliation tables
tasks.detail: Replicate complex multi-sheet Excel logic: merge inventory logs with POS sales, reshape tables with .pivot_table() and .melt(), and export clean Parquet/CSV files.

tasks.title: Document data quality validation checks
tasks.detail: Write assertion checks checking for zero-values in unit price, negative inventory counts, and duplicate transaction IDs, printing an automated summary report.

resources.title: Python Data Science Handbook
resources.why: Provides exact, code-first explanations of Pandas indexing, alignment, and grouping patterns.

resources.title: Pandas Official Documentation
resources.why: Essential for referencing idioms, vectorized string methods, and merge paradigms.

project.title: Automated Multi-Store Inventory Reconciler
project.brief: Build a modular Python script that ingests three dirty POS CSV exports, standardizes SKUs, resolves mismatched pricing, calculates inventory discrepancy metrics, and outputs clean tabular files.
project.deliverable: A reproducible Jupyter Notebook and Python (.py) pipeline script with assertion tests confirming data integrity.

phases.checkpoint: You can load a multi-thousand row messy CSV, correctly coerce date types, resolve string currency fields to floats, and aggregate sales by month without relying on Excel.

phases.title: Exploratory Data Analysis & Strategic Visualization
phases.focus: Transform clean operational tables into commercial insights through rigorous exploratory data analysis (EDA) and publication-grade visual storytelling.
objectives: Formulate and test business hypotheses using statistical distributions and correlation matrices.
Produce uncluttered, decision-oriented charts using Seaborn and Matplotlib.
Translate visual findings into plain-English operational recommendations.

tasks.title: Conduct univariate and bivariate EDA runs
tasks.detail: Calculate distribution metrics (median, skew, IQR) for basket size, unit margins, and delivery delays. Chart distributions using histograms, boxplots, and heatmaps.

tasks.title: Refactor raw plots into publication-standard figures
tasks.detail: Remove chart junk: direct-label lines, drop default plot grids, apply a consistent 2-color highlight palette, and add dynamic business-focused titles and annotations.

tasks.title: Produce an analytical findings draft
tasks.detail: Analyze a retail discount campaign dataset to determine whether price drops drove incremental profit or simply eroded margin. Write 3 actionable takeaways based on the visual evidence.

resources.title: Storytelling with Data
resources.why: Industry standard for converting analytical charts into concise executive communications.

resources.title: DataTalks.Club
resources.why: High-signal peer feedback community for reviewing exploratory projects and data analysis code.

project.title: Retail Margin & Promotion Diagnostic Report
project.brief: Perform a complete EDA on a retail discounting dataset. Deliver 4 polished visual charts comparing discount depth to customer return rate and net gross profit, accompanied by executive annotations.
project.deliverable: A Jupyter Notebook with zero raw unformatted plots and an exported 3-page PDF visual analysis report.

phases.checkpoint: You can build an annotated, decluttered multi-series chart with custom styling and a business subtitle in Matplotlib and Seaborn without using GUI chart builders.

phases.title: End-to-End Portfolio Capstone & Executive Communication
phases.focus: Assemble SQL extraction, Pandas processing, visual EDA, and executive slide deck creation into a single public portfolio project tailored to hiring managers.
objectives: Synthesize SQL, Python, and visualization into a cohesive GitHub project.
Draft professional README documentation outlining context, methodology, caveats, and recommendations.
Create an executive slide deck that proves your ability to communicate with non-technical leaders.

tasks.title: Define problem statement and query source dataset
tasks.detail: Formulate a concrete retail business question (e.g., store network profitability vs. supply chain delays). Extract initial aggregate slices from Postgres via SQL scripts.

tasks.title: Execute analytical modeling and charting in Python
tasks.detail: Ingest SQL extracts into Pandas. Perform cohort analyses, calculate performance KPIs, and generate 5 executive-ready charts highlighting key operational trade-offs.

tasks.title: Build the public GitHub repository and documentation
tasks.detail: Structure the repository with /sql, /notebooks, /data, and /docs folders. Write a comprehensive README covering executive summary, findings, reproducibility instructions, and limitations.

tasks.title: Create an executive slide deck and record walkthrough
tasks.detail: Assemble a 6-slide deck summarizing the business issue, data findings, operational impact, and 3 explicit business recommendations. Record a 5-minute Loom walkthrough.

resources.title: GitHub Docs
resources.why: Essential for mastering professional portfolio repo presentation, markdown, and version control.

project.title: Comprehensive Retail Operations Strategy Capstone
project.brief: Execute a full-stack analytical study evaluating store labor cost versus fulfillment throughput using SQL for aggregation, Python for analysis, and an executive PDF deck for recommendations.
project.deliverable: A public GitHub repository containing documented SQL scripts, clean Python notebooks, and an executive 6-slide presentation deck.

phases.checkpoint: Your capstone repository can be cloned and re-run end-to-end by an external reviewer, clearly demonstrating the data story without explanation.

milestones.title: Complex SQL Script Execution
milestones.proof: A committed SQL file on GitHub executing window functions and CTEs that answers 5 business questions on a real-world relational database.

milestones.title: Autonomous Python Data Cleaning Pipeline
milestones.proof: A clean, functional Python script that ingests, cleans, and joins multiple inconsistent retail CSVs without errors or manual spreadsheet interventions.

milestones.title: Visual Business Analysis Publication
milestones.proof: An annotated 4-chart EDA document identifying margin bottlenecks from promotional sales, presented with actionable takeaways.

milestones.title: Shipped Full-Stack Capstone & Executive Deck
milestones.proof: A public GitHub repository featuring SQL extraction, Python cleaning and EDA, an executive slide deck, and a recorded 5-minute video walkthrough.

finalProject.title: Omnichannel Retail Optimization Engine
finalProject.brief: Analyze 2 years of retail transactions, returns, and inventory fulfillment data across physical stores and e-commerce channels. Identify the root drivers of return-related margin loss, quantify supply chain latency bottlenecks, and deliver an actionable operational roadmap to senior retail leadership.
finalProject.deliverable: A polished GitHub repository containing the database schema, modular SQL aggregation queries, Python data cleaning and statistical EDA notebooks, a structured README with high-signal charts, and a 6-slide executive decision deck.
skillsShown: Relational database querying (PostgreSQL, CTEs, Window Functions)
Git version control and technical documentation
Executive business translation and operational recommendations

successMetrics: Total study and build time tracks within 94 to 96 hours across the 12 weeks.
Ability to write CTEs and window functions from scratch during SQL live-coding interviews.
A GitHub portfolio containing two complete, cleanly formatted projects with reproducible instructions.
A 5-minute recorded presentation explaining the business findings of data analysis to a non-technical stakeholder without using technical jargon.

pitfalls.pitfall: Defaulting back to Excel when data cleaning gets difficult or tedious in Pandas.
pitfalls.fix: Impose a rule: do not open spreadsheet software during Phases 2, 3, and 4. Force yourself to resolve reshaping and aggregation issues using Pandas documentation and syntax.

pitfalls.pitfall: Spending hours memorizing complex algorithm coding challenges that are never asked in junior data analyst interviews.
pitfalls.fix: Focus deliberate practice strictly on SQL joins/aggregations/window functions and Pandas data manipulations instead of LeetCode dynamic programming.

pitfalls.pitfall: Over-relying on AI code generators to output code without understanding line-by-line mechanics.
pitfalls.fix: Require yourself to type and annotate every AI-generated query or code block manually, explaining what each function and argument achieves before running it.

pitfalls.pitfall: Creating generic, academic charts without clear titles, unit labels, or business context.
pitfalls.fix: Always format plots with direct data labels, high-contrast focal colors, informative titles summarizing the takeaway, and clear axes.

nextSteps: Add your capstone repository link and video presentation directly to your resume under a dedicated Projects section.
Conduct 5 mock technical SQL and business problem-solving interviews using standard analyst problem sets.
Network with retail analytics managers on LinkedIn by sharing brief, concrete insights derived from your capstone project.
Explore business intelligence tooling (Tableau or Power BI) as an incremental layer on top of your SQL and Python foundation.
